text:
elaine-partners: Brainstorm: 'split-pay' private-offer for marketplace + appliance bundling. Customer pays appliance upfront (capex) + a 12m commitment for runtime. Offer incentives: marketplace listing fee waived Y1, a hardware rebate escrow that vests on 6mo usage, and a renewal ladder that increases discounts if they scale. Trying to reduce procurement friction while protecting revenue. thoughts?

omar-cloud: Interesting. For hyperscaler listing rules we need to ensure private-offer pricing doesn't violate marketplace policies. Waiving listing fee for Y1 is ok if we document it as a promotional credit. For discount bands I'd propose: Bronze=30k(3%), Silver=120k(9%), Gold=400k(16%). Renewal ladder: additional +2% per year if usage grows >20%.

frank-finance: Accounting flags: hardware rebate escrow must be tracked separately as deferred liability until vesting conditions met. Clawback rules needed for early terminations. Also payout to SIs should be treated as partner expense, not reduction of ARR. We'll need GL mapping and VAT handling.

jana-legal: Agree on clawback. Also require a clear customer acceptance and deployment sign-off for the rebate to vest. Can't have marketing-credit converting to cash. I'll prepare clause: escrow mechanics + termination triggers + listing policy language.

mohit-si: SI asks: 1) allow PS invoicing separate from the committed spend 2) a 6% partner margin paid out from escrow after 90d if adoption > baseline 3) co-announcement approval window (we need 72hr review for public PR). Without co-sell margin, SIs deprioritize.

elaine-partners: Good notes. We should also protect joint announcements: announce only after both parties approve and after first paid invoice, to avoid leak risks. Mohit, baseline usage = projected run-rate in SOW?

mohit-si: yes baseline = SOW estimate month1-3 average. We want simple verification: meter spike + signed acceptance.

omar-cloud: From ops side: tags we need in telemetry: offer:split-pay, sku:appliance, partner_id, listing_promo=true. Also need marketplace-private-offer code in billing so it maps to the marketplace order. Estimate 3 sprints.

frank-finance: Also add a renewal safeguard: if customer downgrades at renewal, we prorate rebate clawback over remaining months. Cap clawback at original rebate amount.

jana-legal: We'll include a max 1-year clawback window and an option for customers to convert leftover escrow into credit for future usage at renewal (not cash).

elaine-partners: Thinking pilot: single-market telco in LATAM with one SI, 6 customers, 10-week pilot. Pilot goals: conversion rate (commit signature -> usage >=70% by month3), SI engagement score, and renewal intent.

omar-cloud: Pilot checklist: 1) create private-offer code 2) add telemetry tags 3) implement rebate-escrow token + vesting rules 4) partner payout pipeline 5) dashboard. ETA if prioritized: 3 sprints.

mohit-si: We also need a simple quote snippet for field. Can someone draft?

elaine-partners: I'll draft a minimal snippet.

frank-finance: Note: ensure any partner margin payments go through partner payout system and include VAT handling. Payouts >50k need procurement sign-off.

jana-legal: Also exclude gov/reg accounts and air-gapped appliances from the marketplace promo.

elaine-partners: Quote snippet draft below — please review quickly:

```
OFFER: Split-Pay Private Offer (Appliance + Runtime)
TERM: 12 months commit for runtime + appliance one-time purchase
BANDS: Bronze 30k -> 3% | Silver 120k -> 9% | Gold 400k -> 16%
MARKETPLACE_PROMO: Listing fee waived Year 1
HARDWARE_REBATE: escrow up to 25% of appliance cost, vests on 6mo usage threshold
SI_MARGIN: 6% of committed paid from escrow after 90d if adoption > baseline
RENEWAL_LADDER: +2% discount per year if usage growth >20% YoY
EXCLUSIONS: govcloud, air-gapped installs
```

mohit-si: LGTM. One ask: make sure SIs can see the escrow status in portal for payout transparency.

omar-cloud: ops: we can add a partner portal view with escrow status, proof attachments, and payout ETA. Add as a separate ticket.

frank-finance: I'll coordinate GL mapping and VAT flows. Expect finance sign-off conditional on escrow ledger and clawback process.

jana-legal: I'll circulate a 1-pg clause and sample contract addendum by EOD Friday.

elaine-partners: Pilot timeline proposal: kickoff May 20, mid-pilot check June 10, pilot end July 1. Deliverables: pilot brief, quote template, legal clause, billing instrumentation, partner portal stub.

ops-bot: Pilot task created: split-pay-latam-telco-1788012345. Checkpoints set: 2024-06-10, 2024-06-24.

mohit-si: Count us in for LATAM pilot. We'll provide 6 candidate customers this week.

elaine-partners: thanks team  we'll use this thread as canonical. I'll pin the pilot brief once it's ready. :rocket:
